title: Connectors
connectSectionDesc: Connect new MCP servers and manage the ones you already have.

secretDialog.title: Connect {{name}}
secretDialog.desc: This connector needs a key to work. It is stored locally in your MCP configuration.

descriptions.exa: Web search and page crawling built for AI. Works out of the box, no key needed.
descriptions.github: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests, and code.
descriptions.linear: Find, create, and update issues, projects, and comments.
descriptions.notion: Search, read, and update pages and databases in your workspace.
descriptions.sentry: Investigate errors, traces, and application performance.
descriptions.atlassian: Work with Jira issues, Confluence pages, and team knowledge.
descriptions.atomicmail: Give your agent its own inbox: read, send, and manage email. No key needed.
descriptions.stripe: Read and manage customers, payments, subscriptions, and invoices.
descriptions.supabase: Query your database, manage projects, and read Supabase docs.
descriptions.cloudflare: Manage Workers, DNS, storage, and observability across your account.
descriptions.posthog: Query product analytics, feature flags, errors, and session data.
descriptions.paypal: Create invoices, track orders and payments, and manage disputes.
descriptions.trello: Read and update boards, lists, and cards.
descriptions.granola: Search and read your meeting notes and transcripts.
descriptions.calcom: Manage bookings, event types, and availability.
descriptions.airtable: Read, create, and update records in your bases.
descriptions.webflow: Manage sites, CMS collections, and pages.
descriptions.firecrawl: Scrape, crawl, search, and extract web pages into LLM-ready data.
descriptions.perplexity: Real-time web research with cited answers from Perplexity.
descriptions.zapier: Run actions across thousands of apps through your Zapier MCP server.
descriptions.resend: Send transactional emails through the Resend API.
descriptions.shopify-dev: Shopify developer docs and GraphQL schemas for building apps.
